'''mrwaltdog Cour Of The Vile Gangster''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile mrwaltdog DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Mostly just your common COTVG deck take a look. Let me know what you think.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Mostly just set up like a normal COTVG deck. If Opponent refuses to come play then you can either use the docking bays to go to them or just get Tatooine: Lar's Moisture Farm out with Expand The Empire on it and drain for a bit. Also if opponent comes with a beatdown force you can't handle just ge the Krayt Dragon out on Tatooine and let him eat a few of the opponents characters. Just make sure your characters are aboard a skiff or the sail barge so you don't get eaten. Often I will lay a trap for my opponent and lay a lone character at the Pit Of Carkoon and then let them come battle me. Well I just sac the character and play Ghhhk to eliminate battle damage. Then next turn I throw out the Sarlacc and let him eat two of their characters placing them out of play. If you are luck then your objective is flipped and you make them lose even more. Pretty cool in my book. I have been able to use this trick in almost every one of my games with the old version of the deck.

I didn't put any BH starships because I just did not see any room for them. Also I looked and saw that I only own one copy of Hidden weapons. Reason why these cards are not in the deck.

Let me know if there are any changes you see to be made.

Thankx
